ba0d0370cf:
My loyal soldiers, the decisive battle is at hand!
Bring the hammer of justice down on the Federation's
incompetent bureaucrats! Sieg Zeon!
1bd68076a2:
Captain Bright, many ships sighted ahead!
It's the Zeon forces!
a4e3d9043e:
We've confirmed it too.
They're stronger than we were told...
How many ships has Zeon gathered?
c83925e1c7: Let's form an interception around your Ra Cailum, Captain.
a053494202:
Understood, Captain Henken.
I'll leave both flanks to you and Captain Murrue.
d207d436c3:
Level one alert! Prepare for anti-ship combat!
This will be a fierce exchange of fire. Stay sharp!
b3902da396:
Forced onto the back foot by the Earth Federation's
offensive, the Zeon forces planned a major counterattack.
17fafd7d94:
They meant to throw Zeon's full strength into
a decisive fleet battle against Jaburo,
the Federation's headquarters.
2fe61cacac:
The Federation, meanwhile, had sensed Zeon's moves.
The veteran captain Bright Noa set up a patrol line
to prepare for the Zeon fleet's attack.
dd9113a9bf:
You underestimated them, Supreme Commander.
We no longer have the strength to go on the offensive.
88c10a1603:
Never mind that, what about Garma!?
Our dear little brother is dead,
how can you two be so calm!?
f2c220e7e5:
Of course I am not calm, Dozle.
That is exactly why Garma's death must not be in vain.
The Zabi family's honor is at stake.
31af915964:
I will report this blunder to Father at Side 3.
You don't mind, do you, Supreme Commander Gihren?
a85fdf7924:
Looks like we managed to drive them off...
Jaburo is safe now.
85bdd62b5b:
We won a fleet battle of this scale
thanks to your command, Captain Bright.
As a fellow captain, I respect you.
d55626af22:
Thank you, Lt. Commander Ramius.
It was only possible thanks to all of you.
513e45a5a9:
Even so, though they lost most of their ships,
Zeon still has plenty of strength left.
The main battlefield will now move to space.
fd5e39e17b:
Yes, we're going up into space too.
The fighting won't end until the Zabis fall!
Let's meet again in the next operation. Good luck!
